pedagogical_depth.justification: Every lesson includes a full expanded_walkthrough naming a specific Kindergarten trap (eyeball comparison, size-mass conflation, height-capacity conflation, gap-measurement, wrong-tool use), with teacher_script, common_misconceptions, and recovery_moves. Both A10.1 and A10.2 are represented in the summative rubric on Ontario's 4-level scale.

instructional_balance.justification: Each lesson follows the Ontario minds_on / action / consolidation arc with explicit duration_minutes (12 + 25 + 13 = 50 min). Action structure 'whole_group_then_centres' (and 'individual' for capstone) gives floor-vs-desk balance. Three rotating stations of 7 min each. Differentiation tiers explicit per lesson.

clarity_communication.justification: Voice is consistent across lessons: Max + Tess anchor every minds-on; vocabulary introduced/reinforced is named explicitly; success_criteria use child-friendly 'I can' phrasing; teacher_script is concrete with quoted dialogue. Worksheets use child-voice instructions; manipulatives have step-by-step prep notes.

alignment.justification: Curriculum codes (A10.1, A10.2) mapped lesson-by-lesson via expectation_lesson_map. Each lesson's primary_expectations align to blueprint codes. The summative rubric covers both expectations with descriptors that match blueprint.curriculum_expectations text exactly. Image-text alignment validation passes with 0 issues.

appearance.justification: Composite generation passes 0 placeholders thanks to the smart_fallback composer plus newly-added MAX and TESS character clipart entries. All worksheet/manipulative images have well-described visual_layout and placement specs. Pre-grade drift check: 0 consistency issues, 0 curriculum issues, 0 image-text issues, 0 placeholders.
